note: Bonny Rigg Camping Club, Becket (Route 8 at Route 20): a members' camping club of about 175 sites, mostly seasonal, on Walker Brook with two ponds; directories (not the operator) report transient RV nights and a pool, store, laundry and member lounge. Its own website forwards to its Facebook page. --Claude
summary: Long-stay test 2 FAILS: a club-run, mostly seasonal park with no operator-posted nightly rate and no booking engine (website forwards to Facebook; Facebook shows only 'Price Range $$'; the $50 RV / $40 tent figure is an unclaimed RoverPass table, last updated 11/15/2024). Presence itself passes (Google Maps open, 4.3 from 72 reviews, phone (413) 623-5366; Facebook 2.3K followers). Cleared the directory-derived hookups, store/laundry/dump, season and reservable. Passport America claim rests only on Campendium; no Hipcamp listing; RoverPass unclaimed - all removed from the note. Gate: no gateway within 40 km (Hartford 64 km), so US$50 applies; the only figures seen ($50 RoverPass, '~$50' Campendium reviewers) sit at the line but neither is an operator rate.
flags: CRITERIA - long-stay test 2 (AWH 2026-10-14 rule): Bonny Rigg markets itself as a 'Camping Club' (Google: 'Bonny Rigg Camping Club Inc'; Berkshires Outside: '175 sites ... member lounge ... build community at the club'), is mostly seasonal (spring imagery shows trailers parked through the wooded loops west of Route 8 before opening), and sells no night on its own site or a booking engine: www.bonnyriggcampground.com 301-forwards to https://www.facebook.com/bonnyrigg.campground, which posts no rate. The only nightly figure is an unclaimed RoverPass table ($50 RV hook-up, $40 tent, 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024') plus Campendium reviewers' '~$50', and neither counts. Fails test 2 -> drop candidate, unless AWH wants a phone call to the park to stand in.
Website: bonnyriggcampground.com is no longer a site - it forwards to the Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/bonnyrigg.campground). Phone 413-623-5366 is correct (Facebook, Google).
Membership question unresolved: whether 'Camping Club' means a buy-in co-op could not be read from any operator page; the old note's 'not a buy-in co-op' rested on directories and was dropped.
